Overall the product is good, but it doesn't meet my pre-install expectations for a dishwasher of this price. If I could do it over again, I would look at models with the fan-assisted drying cycle. Sentence (English): I am a two-person household.
Comments (English): I am a two-person household. It is hard to cook after work, and I hate having to wash dishes. I wanted to use a dishwasher, but the kitchen space is small, and the sink renovation is expensive, so I was worried. LG released a 6-person dishwasher as a self-management type, so I was thinking of buying it in one go, but I subscribed after checking the AS period. Conclusion. It is so good. Stress has disappeared, and I have time to run the dishwasher and have a cup of tea while talking about my day with my husband. I understand what they mean when they say that only those who have used it know~
Comments (Original): 2인가구입니다. 퇴근후에 음식하는것도 힘든데 설거지까지 해야하는게 너무 싫었습니다..식기세척기는 쓰고싶은데 주방 공간은 좁고 씽크대 공사는 비용도 부담스러워 고민하고 있었는데 LG에서 자가관리 타입으로 6인용 식기세척기가 나왔다고해서  일시불로 살까하다가 AS기간보고 구독했습니다.  결론은..너무 좋습니다. ㅎㅎ 스트레스가 사라졌고 식세기 돌리고 남편이랑 오늘 하루 얘기하며 차 한잔 하는 시간이 생겼습니다. 써본 사람만 안다는게 무슨 말인지 알겠어요~

Sentence (English): Now that we've had this dishwasher for 10 months, I can provide pros and cons on its day-to-day performance.
Comments (English): [ Inferior Materials and Manufacturing ] || ---------------- || Now that we've had this dishwasher for 10 months, I can provide pros and cons on its day-to-day performance. Pro: It gets the job done - have not had any issues with wash performance. I don't have any devices to measure sound level, but while it isn't loud, it isn't exactly quiet either. We've learned to wait to start it if we are watching a movie or a TV show at night, because we will hear it washing during quieter parts of the shows. Cons: First thing would be that it doesn't ever really do the AutoRelease thing. Not really a big deal for us, but it is worth mentioning. I would say the manufacturing process leaves a good bit to be desired. On the upper rack there is a plastic slider that allows the entire row of tines to be angled for either regular cups and mugs or wine glasses. The plastic arm that controls this comes off after EVERY SINGLE WASH and has to be reattached. Also, we recently discovered that the top face plate (with the buttons) has several small chips and a large 1" crack running vertically on it. I contacted Samsung and they basically told me "tough luck, we consider that physical damage so we won't be covering it". I've tried to appeal this but it has become evident that Samsung will not stand by their products and you're just going to have to "set your expectations" as I was told on the phone by the representative. Needless to say, Samsung has received their last penny from this family of five.

I used to think I could live without a dishwasher~! But after using it once, I don't want to go back to my life without a dishwasher. I'm in the countryside, so I bought it on the 11th and had it delivered and installed on the 21st. It's so convenient that I can have it installed on the desired date. Since the kids are eating three meals a day at home during the vacation, it seems like I have to cook rice again after eating and washing the dishes. With the dishwasher, it's so convenient because I don't have to wash the dishes after eating. I can have some time to myself. It was easy to install because it's not built-in. The installer came and drilled a hole and diligently installed it, and he even checked to make sure there were no leaks. It was so convenient. My kitchen is small, so I looked closely at the size, but when I received it, it seemed a little bigger than I thought, so I was surprised, but it was fine after installation. It's so easy to use that I don't even need to look at the manual, so I think it would be good for the elderly to use. The auto-open function is so convenient because you can run the dishwasher and do other things or go out. Since the dishwasher detergent didn't arrive, I ran it without it and the non-greasy cups, forks, and ssamjang paper towels were clean. They were so clean and fluffy, I'm so happy. It says it's for 6 people, but it's a little small for a 5-person household to put in soup bowls, rice bowls, side dish plates, etc. However, it's so convenient because I don't have to wash the dishes. Since it is a Coupang 2-year free warranty A/S product, I think I can use it without worrying about breakdown. * Compact size for 6 people design * Practical storage and efficient interior design * Powerful cleaning Wide washing blades * Efficient drying system Automatic door opening method It can be used in standard mode when the contamination level is low and in strong mode when the contamination level is high, so you can choose according to the situation. A large family would need a dishwasher with a larger capacity, but it seems perfect for a small home or a household of 3-4 people.

Product Name: Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher, White, MDWTT0608(W)-KR, On-site Installation. Purchase Date: February 11, 2025. Delivery Date: February 21, 2025. I used to think I could live without a dishwasher, but after using it once, I don't want to go back. I'm out of town, so I purchased it on the 11th and had it delivered and installed on the 21st. It's so convenient to be able to have it installed on my preferred date. Since the kids are home for three meals during the school break, it seems like I have to do the dishes after meals. With the dishwasher, I don't have to wash dishes after meals, which is so convenient. I can have some time to myself. Since it's not built-in, installation was easy. The installer came and drilled a hole and worked hard. They installed it and even checked for leaks, which was very convenient. My kitchen is small, so I carefully checked the dimensions, but upon receiving it, it seemed slightly larger than I expected. I was a little taken aback, but after installation, it was fine. It's so easy to operate that I didn't even need to look at the manual, so I think it'll be great for seniors. The auto-open feature is so convenient that I can run the dishwasher and go out to do other things. Since dishwasher detergent wasn't provided, I used it without it, and it still came out clean. It's so clean and fluffy, which is a real plus. It's said to be for 6 people, but it's a bit small for a family of 5, with soup, rice, and side dish plates. That's a shame. But it's so convenient not having to wash dishes. Since it's a Coupang 2-year free warranty product, I think I'll be able to use it without worrying about breakdowns. * Compact size for 6 people. * Practical storage and efficient interior design. * Powerful cleaning with wide washing blades. * Efficient drying system with automatic door opening. It can be used in standard mode when the contamination level is low and in strong mode when the contamination level is high, so you can choose according to the situation. Large families will need a dishwasher with a larger capacity, but it seems perfect for small homes or households of 3-4 people.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.제품명 : 미디어 카운터탑 앱연동 자동문열림 6인용 식기세척기, 화이트, MDWTT0608(W)-KR, 방문설치구매일 : 2025. 02. 11배송일 : 2025. 02. 21식기세척기 없어도 사는데 지장 없다~!! 하고 살았는데한번사용해보디 식기세척기 없었던 삶으로 돌아가기 싫어요~지방에 내려가 있느라 11일에 구매고 21에 배송 설치 받았어요.원하는날짜에 설치 받을수 있어서 너무 편리합니다.방학해서 아이들이 집에서 삼시세끼 먹다보니 밥먹고 설거지 하면 또 밥을 해야하는거 같네요.ㅎㅎ식기세척기들이고 나니 식사후에 설거지 시간이 없으니 너무 편리합니다.나만의 시간을 가질수 있어요~빌트인이 아니라서 설치가 쉬웠어요. 설치기사님께서 오셔서 구멍하나 뚫고 열심히 설치해주시고, 물 세는곳 없나 확인도 해주시고 너무 편리했습니다.주방이 좁아서 사이즈를 열심히 봤는데, 받고보니 생각했던거보다 살짝 큰거 같아서 당황했지만 설치하고 나니 괜찮았어요.설명서를 보지 않고서도 작동을 할수 있을 정도로 쉬워서 어르신들 사용하기에도 좋을거 같아요.식기세척기 돌려놓고 다른일하거나 외출을 해도 자동 문열림 기능이 있어서 너무 편리합니다. 식기세척기 전용 세제가 도착하지 않아서 세제없이  기름기 없는 컵이랑 포크, 쌈장종지 돌려봤는데도 깨끗합니다.깨끗하고 뽀송해서 너무 기분이 좋네요.6인용이라고 되어있지만 5인가구 국그릇 밥그릇 반찬 접시 다 넣기는 살짝 작은거 같아서 아쉽습니다. 하지만 설거지를 안해도 되니 너무 편리해요. 쿠팡 2년 무상 보증 A/S 상품이라서 고장 걱정 없이 사용할거같아요.* 6인용 디자인 컴팩트한 사이즈* 실용적인 수납 효율적인 내부 설계* 강력한 세척 와이드형 세척날개* 효율적인 건조 시스템 자동 문 열림 방식낮은 오염도일때는 표준모드로 높은 오염도 일때는 강력모드로 사용 가능해서 상황에 따라서 선택 가능해요. 대가족은 더 큰 용량의 식세기를 사용해야겠지만, 집에 공간이 작거나 3~4인 가구에서 사용하기에는 안성 맞춤 인거 같아요.

I used to think I could live without a dishwasher, but after using it once, I don't want to go back. I'm out of town, so I purchased it on the 11th and had it delivered and installed on the 21st. It's so convenient to be able to have it installed on my preferred date. Since the kids are home for three meals during the school break, it seems like I have to do the dishes after meals. With the dishwasher, I don't have to wash dishes after meals, which is so convenient. I can have some time to myself. Since it's not built-in, installation was easy. The installer came and drilled a hole and worked hard. They installed it and even checked for leaks, which was very convenient. My kitchen is small, so I carefully checked the dimensions, but upon receiving it, it seemed slightly larger than I expected. I was a little taken aback, but after installation, it was fine. It's so easy to operate that I didn't even need to look at the manual, so I think it'll be great for seniors. The auto-open feature is so convenient that I can run the dishwasher and go out to do other things. Since dishwasher detergent wasn't provided, I used it without it, and it still came out clean. It's so clean and fluffy, which is a real plus. It's said to be for 6 people, but it's a bit small for a family of 5, with soup, rice, and side dish plates. That's a shame. But it's so convenient not having to wash dishes. Since it's a Coupang 2-year free warranty product, I think I'll be able to use it without worrying about breakdowns. * Compact size for 6 people. * Practical storage and efficient interior design. * Powerful cleaning with wide washing blades. * Efficient drying system with automatic door opening. It can be used in standard mode when the contamination level is low and in strong mode when the contamination level is high, so you can choose according to the situation. Large families will need a dishwasher with a larger capacity, but it seems perfect for small homes or households of 3-4 people.

I used to think I could live without a dishwasher, but after using it once, I don't want to go back. I'm out of town, so I purchased it on the 11th and had it delivered and installed on the 21st. It's so convenient to be able to have it installed on my preferred date. Since the kids are home for three meals during the school break, it seems like I have to do the dishes after meals. With the dishwasher, I don't have to wash dishes after meals, which is so convenient. I can have some time to myself. Since it's not built-in, installation was easy. The installer came and drilled a hole and worked hard. They installed it and even checked for leaks, which was very convenient. My kitchen is small, so I carefully checked the dimensions, but upon receiving it, it seemed slightly larger than I expected. I was a little taken aback, but after installation, it was fine. It's so easy to operate that I didn't even need to look at the manual, so I think it'll be great for seniors. The auto-open feature is so convenient that I can run the dishwasher and go out to do other things. Since dishwasher detergent wasn't provided, I used it without it, and it still came out clean. It's so clean and fluffy, which is a real plus. It's said to be for 6 people, but it's a bit small for a family of 5, with soup, rice, and side dish plates. That's a shame. But it's so convenient not having to wash dishes. Since it's a Coupang 2-year free warranty product, I think I'll be able to use it without worrying about breakdowns. * Compact size for 6 people. * Practical storage and efficient interior design. * Powerful cleaning with wide washing blades. * Efficient drying system with automatic door opening. It can be used in standard mode when the contamination level is low and in strong mode when the contamination level is high, so you can choose according to the situation. Large families will need a dishwasher with a larger capacity, but it seems perfect for small homes or households of 3-4 people.

The height of the middle rack can be adjusted and we were able to raise it enough to accommodate our oversized dinner plates without the spray arm bashing onto them.

Comments (English): [ Quality Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We replaced our old Bosch dishwasher that gave us 16 years of maintenance free use with this Bosch 500 series dishwasher. When the cycle is completed the door pops open & our Apple watches & iPhones are notified that the cycle has completed. The app also keeps use stats including KW's used, Gallons of water used & number of cycles used. The dishwasher is very quiet. Unlike our older Bosch this new one even dries plastic dish ware, at least with the 60 Speed cycle we most often use. Long term reliability is unknown at this time. All in all , we are very satisfied with this particular Bosch dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The Bosch SMV8TCX01E is a great dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Perfection ] || ---------------- || The Bosch SMV8TCX01E is a great dishwasher! Its fully integrated design with invisible control panel is elegant and fits perfectly into my kitchen. With a capacity of 14 place settings, 3 drawers as well as its removable modules, it will allow you to wash large containers, it will therefore be perfect for a large family. The dishes, whatever their degree of dirt, always come out clean and perfectly dry. Its operation is silent at only 43 dB, so it will be perfect for an open kitchen without it being gendered. Its energy class A is an asset with the price of electricity these days. It offers 8 programs and 5 options, including an eco and an intensive. Different settings adjustable sound, water hardness, cold or hot water connection, quantity of dishwashing liquid and so many others. In addition, with Wi-Fi connectivity it gives you access to the Home Connect application which allows you to program the delayed start, launch a program, be alerted of the end of the cycle. A nice little gadget, the floor backlighting shows you the different stages of your cycle as well as the end time. As you can see, this dishwasher offers a modern and practical experience!

La vaisselle, quelque soit son degré de saleté ressort toujours propre et parfaitement sèche. Son fonctionnement est silencieux pour seulement 43 dB, cela sera donc parfait pour une cuisine ouverte sans que ça puisse vous genrer . Sa classe énergétique A est un atout avec le prix de l électricité de nos jours. Il propose 8 programmes et 5 options, dont un éco et un intensif. Sentence (English): We recently moved house and in this new home we have space for a dishwasher, so, said and done!
Comments (English): [ The scrubbing is going to end. ] || ---------------- || We recently moved house and in this new home we have space for a dishwasher, so, said and done! We bought this LG and have been testing it for a few days. It is important to know that before its first use you have to load it with salt and do a first rinse without anything in it. Once done, we did our first test with dishes and we were really happy with the result. We did not rinse most of the pieces to see if it was able to remove residue (nothing exaggerated) and it did its job without any problem. Everything came out clean and dry for the most part, except for a pot with some water in it, but that was because we did not place it correctly inside (it should be placed downwards, novice stuff). We have tried the automatic mode and we consider that it cleans very well. The cycles last between 2 and 4 hours each, we did not know they were so long, but looking at the manual we see that the water and electricity consumption is not too high. The noise is almost imperceptible. We have the living room separated from the kitchen and you cannot hear anything. If you are in the same kitchen, if there is any other noise from the microwave, stove, etc., you can't hear it anymore. If there is total silence, it is only very faint. We are very happy with the noise level of the appliance. I would like to highlight the cutlery tray as something super practical, and the fact that the intermediate tray can be adjusted in height is another of the strong points of this dishwasher. We have adopted the routine of filling it during the day, turning it on after dinner and emptying it the next day. We have not found any traces of lime or stains on the glassware. We set the water hardness according to the instruction manual. (It includes a kit to easily check the hardness). In terms of aesthetics, we like the matte metallic colour it has, and it hardly leaves fingerprints. We have been wanting to have a dishwasher for many years and it has finally arrived. No more scrubbing!
Comments (Original): [ El fregar se va a acabar ] || ---------------- || Cambiamos de casa hace poco y en esta nueva vivienda tenemos espacio para un lavavajillas, así que, ¡dicho y hecho! Adquirimos este LG y hemos estado probándolo durante unos días. Es importante saber que antes de su primer uso hay que cargarlo de sal y hacer un primer aclarado sin nada dentro. Una vez hecho, hicimos nuestra primera prueba con vajilla y quedamos realmente contentos con el resultado. No enjuagamos la mayoría de las piezas para comprobar si era capaz de retirar restos (nada exagerado) y cumplió sin problema. Todo salió limpio y seco en su mayoría, salvo alguna cacerola con algo de agua dentro, pero porque no la colocamos correctamente dentro (debe ponerse hacia abajo, cosas de novatos). Hemos probado el modo automático y consideramos que limpia muy bien. Los ciclos durante entre 2 y 4 horas cada uno, no sabíamos que eran tan largos, pero mirándooslo el manual vemos que el consumo de agua y de electricidad no es demasiado alto. El ruido es casi imperceptible. Nosotros tenemos el salón separado de la cocina y no se oye nada. Si estás en la misma cocina, con que haya cualquier otro ruido de microondas, fuegos, etc. ya no se oye. Si hay silencio total, tan solo muy levemente. Muy contentos con el nivel sonoro del aparato. Quiero destacar la bandeja de cubiertos como algo super práctico, y que la bandeja intermedia se pueda regular en altura es otro de los puntos fuertes de este lavavajillas. Hemos tomado la rutina de llenarlo durante el día, encenderlo después de cenar y vaciarlo al día siguiente. No hemos encontrado restos de cal ni manchas en la cristalería. Configuramos la dureza del agua según el manual de instrucciones. (Incluye un kit para comprobar la dureza fácilmente). En el apartado estético, nos gusta el color metalizado mate que tiene, y no se le quedan apenas las huellas marcadas. Llevábamos muchos años queriendo tener lavavajillas y por fin ha llegado. ¡Se acabó el fregar!

Comments (English): [ Worst installation company. ] || ---------------- || My Lowes used CRST home solutions for our installation.I bought my dishwasher on Black Friday of 2024, I get scheduled installation Dec. 20th with a window of 7am-7pm. All Lowes has offered me for wanting my installation fee waived, is just $100. Does that seem fair for 3-4 days of leave from work? So do with that information what you will.

Sentence (English): I was extremely excited for this dishwasher to update a 6 year old IKEA unit.
Comments (English): [ Inconsistent quality from factory ] || ---------------- || I was extremely excited for this dishwasher to update a 6 year old IKEA unit. It's been nothing but problems. 1 week in and we had to have the motor replaced due to an issue. The tech was nice enough, but scratched the unit during the install, but I had to sign my life away to get it fixed so recourse is limited. Getting through to KitchenAid took an hour +, then some finagling to get a tech to come out to work on the unit under warranty in the first place. Now it's been fixed, but still so much louder than our previous unit (sounds like a waterfall running and a firehose filling), which the tech says is normal, but everyone that comes through agrees is an major issue. Just a loss what to do with it - maybe another hour on the line with customer service to hope for another tech that agrees there is a problem. The thing is my in laws has this same or model and love it, quiet as can be. Beware of duds.

Sentence (English): We recently moved house and in this new home we have space for a dishwasher, so, said and done!
Comments (English): [ The scrubbing is going to end. ] || ---------------- || We recently moved house and in this new home we have space for a dishwasher, so, said and done! We bought this LG and have been testing it for a few days. It is important to know that before its first use you have to load it with salt and do a first rinse without anything in it. Once done, we did our first test with dishes and we were really happy with the result. We did not rinse most of the pieces to see if it was able to remove residue (nothing exaggerated) and it did its job without any problem. Everything came out clean and dry for the most part, except for a pot with some water in it, but that was because we did not place it correctly inside (it should be placed downwards, novice stuff). We have tried the automatic mode and we consider that it cleans very well. The cycles last between 2 and 4 hours each, we did not know they were so long, but looking at the manual we see that the water and electricity consumption is not too high. The noise is almost imperceptible. We have the living room separated from the kitchen and you cannot hear anything. If you are in the same kitchen, any other noise from the microwave, stove, etc. will not be heard. If there is complete silence, it will only be heard very slightly. We are very happy with the noise level of the appliance. I would like to highlight the cutlery tray as something super practical, and the fact that the intermediate tray can be adjusted in height is another of the strong points of this dishwasher. We have adopted the routine of filling it during the day, turning it on after dinner and emptying it the next day. We have not found any traces of lime or stains on the glassware. We set the water hardness according to the instruction manual. (It includes a kit to easily check the hardness). In terms of aesthetics, we like the matte metallic colour it has, and it hardly leaves fingerprints. We have been wanting to have a dishwasher for many years and it has finally arrived. No more scrubbing!
Comments (Original): [ El fregar se va a acabar ] || ---------------- || Cambiamos de casa hace poco y en esta nueva vivienda tenemos espacio para un lavavajillas, así que, ¡dicho y hecho! Adquirimos este LG y hemos estado probándolo durante unos días. Es importante saber que antes de su primer uso hay que cargarlo de sal y hacer un primer aclarado sin nada dentro. Una vez hecho, hicimos nuestra primera prueba con vajilla y quedamos realmente contentos con el resultado. No enjuagamos la mayoría de las piezas para comprobar si era capaz de retirar restos (nada exagerado) y cumplió sin problema. Todo salió limpio y seco en su mayoría, salvo alguna cacerola con algo de agua dentro, pero porque no la colocamos correctamente dentro (debe ponerse hacia abajo, cosas de novatos). Hemos probado el modo automático y consideramos que limpia muy bien. Los ciclos durante entre 2 y 4 horas cada uno, no sabíamos que eran tan largos, pero mirándooslo el manual vemos que el consumo de agua y de electricidad no es demasiado alto. El ruido es casi imperceptible. Nosotros tenemos el salón separado de la cocina y no se oye nada. Si estás en la misma cocina, con que haya cualquier otro ruido de microondas, fuegos, etc. ya no se oye. Si hay silencio total, tan solo muy levemente. Muy contentos con el nivel sonoro del aparato. Quiero destacar la bandeja de cubiertos como algo super práctico, y que la bandeja intermedia se pueda regular en altura es otro de los puntos fuertes de este lavavajillas. Hemos tomado la rutina de llenarlo durante el día, encenderlo después de cenar y vaciarlo al día siguiente. No hemos encontrado restos de cal ni manchas en la cristalería. Configuramos la dureza del agua según el manual de instrucciones. (Incluye un kit para comprobar la dureza fácilmente). En el apartado estético, nos gusta el color metalizado mate que tiene, y no se le quedan apenas las huellas marcadas. Llevábamos muchos años queriendo tener lavavajillas y por fin ha llegado. ¡Se acabó el fregar!

Would recommend.

Sentence (English): This is my 2nd Bosch Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Such a great dishwasher with great options ] || ---------------- || This is my 2nd Bosch Dishwasher. My 1st one lasted over 12 years without giving me a single issue, so when I needed a new one, the only decision I had to make was which Bosch model I would be getting. I decided on the 500 Series with the 3rd drawer. It comes equiped with a red light that projects onto the floor while it's running. (picture included) Since the controls are hidden, I wanted to make sure I knew if it was running because they are very quiet. Since this model has wifi, I receive a notification every time the cycle is done anyhow. My favorite features of the 500 Series: The 3rd drawer at the top and the smaller silverware basket. With these 2 featuers, I have so much more room! In all honesty, I kept my old silverware basket since it's twice as large, just in case I find I need it. But I've been using the new smaller basket and i haven't missed the larger one. Not yet. But it's just the 2 of us here and the basket is completely filled each wash so I feel the large basket will be needed. With the extra room I like being able to load up the dishwasher with pots, large bowls, and caserole dishes. My absolutely favorite feature is being able to change the height of either side of the middle drawer with a push of a button. (My previous model I had to remove the drawer completely in order to change the height and it was always level). I've had this 500 Series for less than a month and I've changed the height on either side several times already. For those who are buying their first Bosch, please note you MUST have jetdry in order for the dishwasher to dry correctly so make sure you pick some up on your way home. Also; there are different drying options on the dishwashers. This one has Auto Air Dry. With this feature, the door automatically opens at the end of the cycle to let the heat escape. This means if the door is natually open a few inches unless you push the door all the way closed. (I hope this makes sense; see picture) I didn't like it at first because I don't like the way it looks. But I got into the habit pretty quickly of closing the door all the way. There are videos on the Bosch page showing you the different features. I suggest watching them. It helped me out a great deal.

Sentence (English): After careful research we purchased in January of 2021.
Comments (English): [ Run, Don't Walk Away from this Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After careful research we purchased in January of 2021. Paid the price of $1222.12. Expensive, but I felt confident purchasing a KitchenAid. Loved the design, ease of use and especially how quiet it was. It was 3.4 years of dishwasher bliss when in June 2024, it stopped filling with water. After reading online chatter about this KitchenAid dishwasher, I became very concerned that it was a pump filter that was exceptionally expensive to repair and could possible go out again. Sure enough, an Appliance Repair Technician diagnosed a pump filter fail to a whopping $411 price tag. We sucked it up and paid for the repair. Why? We'd had it such a short time, so many good reviews and we really do like the way that it works (when it works). Unfortunately, 8 months after the expensive repair, the dishwasher is once again not filling with water. Are we going to repair it? Absolutely not! $1222 + $411 = $1633/4 years. $408 per year is pretty expensive for the use of a dishwasher. Please don't waste your money on this one.

Sentence (English): After 18 years with a dishwasher of a similar range, the leap in quality is evident.
Comments (English): [ A leap in quality and technology ] || ---------------- || After 18 years with a dishwasher of a similar range, the leap in quality is evident. It still fulfills its primary function, but it does so better (effectiveness), with lower energy costs (efficiency), and more quietly (convenience). Among the aspects that surprised me most was the "Home Connect" app and its programming and energy-saving management (very useful for those of us on a time-of-use electricity plan). It was a surprise (and one I will try) that you can download new programs to the dishwasher, opening up the range of options beyond the "usual" ones. I was a little surprised (I need to try it more) by the duration of the ECO program (longer than I had read), although it's true that it lasts two hours, followed by drying and opening the door. As a negative point about the interior design, having the cutlery tray loaded makes it almost impossible to fit small dishes on the top and large ones on the bottom, or both. And it's a matter of millimeters (on my dishes, of course). In short, a good dishwasher whose higher cost (due to the energy class) is amortized over the expected useful life of the appliance.

Ha sido una sorpresa (que probaré) que se puedan 'descargar' nuevos programas al lavavajillas, abriendo el abanico de opciones más allá de los 'habituales'.Un poco extrañado (tengo que probarlo más) con la duración del programa ECO (mayor que lo que había leído), aunque es cierto que son dos horas de actividad y el resto secado y apertura de puerta.Por ponerle un pero al diseño interior, al tener cargada la bandeja de cubiertos es casi imposible poner platos pequeños en la superior y grandes en la inferior, o una cosa u otra. Sentence (English): I would never buy an LG dishwasher ever again after the nightmare issue with the last one.
Comments (English): [ Buy at your own risk ] || ---------------- || I would never buy an LG dishwasher ever again after the nightmare issue with the last one. LG knew it had a defect of moisture getting into control panel which basically renders the dishwasher unusable. Mine started acting weird after about 3 years. Whenever I went to start, it would blink the time then after pushing the start button it counts down from 4 to 1 then the time keeps blinking. The other issue with it was it would stop multiple times during cycle, usually a minimum of 3 times. Cycle would never complete.I'm disgusted with LG for letting them go out past QC knowing it was an issue and never recalled them. Comments (English): [ If you want dry dishes, buy this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After a few months and a few failed fixes, we were tired of our old dishwasher not drying at all. The good: the noise level is lower than our previous dishwasher, you can definitely still hear it running though. I believe I have the dishwasher level, but a slight forward tilt may solve this issue. The instructions say level though. I also don't like the drain line connector position, it requires you to use an L shaped connection and the location of the connection makes it difficult to route the drain tube.Overall, I'm happy with this dishwasher. There were a lot of negatives reviews, but my experience with delivery and install was smooth and it seems to be doing a great job washing and drying out dishes.

The most important thing is the cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || Since the beginning of our marriage, my husband has been adamant about buying a dishwasher, so I hesitated and finally bought it. The worries were worthless, and I'm extremely satisfied with the result! The most important factor is cleaning power, which seems to depend on playing Tetris with the dishes. For me, I simply rinse seasoned dishes with water before putting them back in, and the cleaning power is incredible! What I love most is that even glass containers for kimchi tend to have a stubborn smell even after washing. But using the dishwasher has completely eliminated the kimchi smell! It's amazing. I usually use a lot of hot water to remove food and odors when washing dishes, but using a dishwasher is so great because I only use a set amount of water! I think it'll save water! The Minix dishwasher holds 6L of water! (For reference.) It's perfect for a two-person household! Since I'm a dual-income working mom, I have to deal with dishes left over after dinner. I put it in the lunch box I brought to work, and the amount is just right. It's the best when I can run the dishwasher and do other housework or rest. Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open Dishwasher for 6 People (Ivory, MDWTT0608(A)-KR) Purchase Review: I purchased the **Media Countertop Dishwasher (6 People)** for my family of four. Since it was installed in person, I'm sharing my experience and the pros and cons of using it. Installation & First Impressions: The in-person installation was convenient because I didn't have to install it myself. I appreciated the friendly and personalized installation process. While it was larger than I expected, it fits my space perfectly, and the ivory color creates a clean look. As a 6-person dishwasher, it doesn't take up much space and is the perfect size for a family of four. Ease of Use & Noise: The intuitive operation makes it easy for even first-time users. It's quieter than expected during operation, allowing for comfortable nighttime use. However, the door automatically opens after washing and is quite noisy during drying. At first, I thought it was broken because of the strange noise. Cleaning & Drying Performance: Even on standard mode, the washing power is excellent, completely removing ramen oil. However, it's important to only use dishwasher-safe products! I added a plastic tumbler, but it deformed because it wasn't dishwasher-safe. Drying Performance: The door automatically opens after washing and drying begins, but it doesn't dry completely. Glass containers dry best, while plastic containers still retain moisture. Pressing the "Add Dry" button doesn't completely dry the container. Features & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity. Automatic operation is possible via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which is moderate, is not overly high, making it convenient to use. You can check the amount of water used during the wash in the app. Interior Lighting: The product description states there's an interior light, but it didn't turn on. Please review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. Connects to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Low power consumption makes it easy to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! The cleaning power is satisfactory, but the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

Review of the Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open Dishwasher for 6 People (Ivory, MDWTT0608(A)-KR). I purchased the **Media Countertop Dishwasher (6 People)** for my family of four. Since it was installed on-site, I'm sharing my experience of both the conveniences and the drawbacks. Installation & First Impressions. The on-site installation was convenient because I didn't have to install it myself. I was also impressed with the friendly installation process, which was tailored to my needs. While it was larger than I expected, it fit the space I had. The ivory color creates a clean look. As a 6-person dishwasher, it doesn't take up much space and is the perfect size for a family of four. Ease of Use & Noise. The intuitive operation makes it easy for even first-time users. It's surprisingly quiet during operation, allowing for comfortable nighttime use. However, the door automatically opens after washing and is quite noisy during drying. At first, I thought it was broken because of the strange noise. Cleaning & Drying Performance. Cleaning Performance. Even on standard mode, the machine has excellent cleaning power, completely removing ramen grease. However, it's important to only use dishwasher-safe products! I added a plastic tumbler, but it deformed because it wasn't dishwasher-safe. Drying performance: The door automatically opens after washing and the dryer begins, but it doesn't dry completely. Glass containers dry best, while plastic containers still retain moisture. Pressing the "Add Dry" button doesn't completely dry the container. Functionality & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity allows automatic operation via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature during use. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which isn't high, is reasonable for use. The app allows you to check the amount of water used during the wash. Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. It can be linked to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Its low power consumption makes it convenient to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

While it was larger than I expected, it fit the space I had. The ivory color creates a clean look. As a 6-person dishwasher, it doesn't take up much space and is the perfect size for a family of four. Ease of Use & Noise. The intuitive operation makes it easy for even first-time users. Even on standard mode, the machine has excellent cleaning power, completely removing ramen grease. However, it's important to only use dishwasher-safe products! I added a plastic tumbler, but it deformed because it wasn't dishwasher-safe. Drying performance: The door automatically opens after washing and the dryer begins, but it doesn't dry completely. Glass containers dry best, while plastic containers still retain moisture. Pressing the "Add Dry" button doesn't completely dry the container. Functionality & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity allows automatic operation via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature during use. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which isn't high, is reasonable for use. The app allows you to check the amount of water used during the wash. Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. It can be linked to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Its low power consumption makes it convenient to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

While it was larger than I expected, it fit the space I had. The ivory color creates a clean look. Functionality & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity allows automatic operation via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature during use. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which isn't high, is reasonable for use. The app allows you to check the amount of water used during the wash. Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. It can be linked to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Its low power consumption makes it convenient to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

Since it was installed on-site, I'm sharing my experience of both the conveniences and the drawbacks. Installation & First Impressions. The on-site installation was convenient because I didn't have to install it myself. I was also impressed with the friendly installation process, which was tailored to my needs. While it was larger than I expected, it fit the space I had. The ivory color creates a clean look. As a 6-person dishwasher, it doesn't take up much space and is the perfect size for a family of four. Ease of Use & Noise. The intuitive operation makes it easy for even first-time users. It's surprisingly quiet during operation, allowing for comfortable nighttime use. However, the door automatically opens after washing and is quite noisy during drying. At first, I thought it was broken because of the strange noise. Cleaning & Drying Performance. Cleaning Performance. Even on standard mode, the machine has excellent cleaning power, completely removing ramen grease. However, it's important to only use dishwasher-safe products! I added a plastic tumbler, but it deformed because it wasn't dishwasher-safe. Drying performance: The door automatically opens after washing and the dryer begins, but it doesn't dry completely. Glass containers dry best, while plastic containers still retain moisture. Pressing the "Add Dry" button doesn't completely dry the container. Functionality & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity allows automatic operation via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature during use. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which isn't high, is reasonable for use. The app allows you to check the amount of water used during the wash. Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. It can be linked to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Its low power consumption makes it convenient to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

While it was larger than I expected, it fit the space I had. The ivory color creates a clean look. Glass containers dry best, while plastic containers still retain moisture. Pressing the "Add Dry" button doesn't completely dry the container. Functionality & Convenience: Wi-Fi connectivity allows automatic operation via a smartphone app, but I personally find manual operation more convenient. The ability to pause the wash and add additional dishes is a convenient feature during use. I purchased a detergent from Coupang that doesn't require rinse aid. Power consumption: 1170W, which isn't high, is reasonable for use. The app allows you to check the amount of water used during the wash. Internal lighting: The product description states there's an internal light, but it doesn't turn on. Review the user manual. Overall Review & Recommendation: Pros: The size is perfect for a family of four. Powerful cleaning power (especially excellent at removing grease). The automatic door opening function allows for natural drying. It can be linked to a smartphone app (you can check water usage after washing). Its low power consumption makes it convenient to use. Cons: The drying performance isn't perfect (especially for plastic containers). It's noisy during drying, and the strange noises can be disconcerting at first. The interior light doesn't work (refer to the user manual). Only use dishwasher-safe dishes (regular plastic dishes can be warped). Overall: A must-have for those who hate washing dishes! While the cleaning power is satisfactory, the drying performance is somewhat disappointing. While it does have Wi-Fi, manual operation may be more convenient. Always check if it's dishwasher-safe when using plastic dishes. Recommendation: Highly recommended if you find dishwashing tiresome and are looking for a product with strong cleaning power. If you're expecting perfect drying performance, you may be disappointed.

Sentence (English): Horrible experience.
Comments (English): [ The worst dishwasher I've ever had. ] || ---------------- || Horrible experience. We purchased the double drawer and matching fridge for our kitchen redo. Big mistake as we've had nothing but problems with the dishwasher. First, it didn't clean. We adjusted and basically wash first. Then, the top drawer wouldn't drain, leaving multiple cups worth of water in the bottom. GE tried to get out of honoring their warranty because of the time it took to get someone to our house after not appearing for scheduled repair appointment. Finally another person came to “solve” the problem, and changed the computer in the top part of the unit. The computer wasn't the problem, I explained again that either the hose or the drain are malfunctioning. He did not listen, replaced the computer piece, and it still did not solve the problem. Weeks later, a third repair person came to replace the drain part. He said it was fixed, but upon running a test run, it is once again full of well over 2 cups of water and won't stop beeping. These units are expensive, and clearly we are not the only ones with the same issues. It seems as if the repair people are not actual plumbers and just following one troubleshooting step, not solving the issue. What a waste of money. And to be told that it's out of warranty because of their own delays is troubling. 3 visits, still doesn't work. Thankfully the bottom drawer works but that hardly fits our plates, let alone any larger items. Not worth the money.

Comments (English): [ <폴센트앱으로 가격보시고 쌀때 구입하시길 권장드립니다> ] || ---------------- || Since this product's price fluctuates significantly, I added it to my cart and purchased it at the lowest price using the Polscent app. I recommend that you also use the Polscent app to register products on Coupang and compare prices before buying. This is very useful because Coupang's product prices fluctuate so much. Fortunately, the color matches my cabinets well, which I really like. Since it is a built-in type, no separate drilling was needed for the base, and the baseboards fit perfectly. I really liked the connectivity since it is a SmartThings compatible product. However, even though it is a new apartment, they said they would reinforce the upper cabinets, which added an extra 50,000 won, and that was a bit of a letdown. They didn't show me exactly what was being reinforced, so honestly, I couldn't tell. There was nothing under the induction cooktop either. Regarding how to add salt or clean the drum, it depends on the technician, but they mentioned that they use a brand called "Bonju Salt" a lot. It seems only LG uses salt. Still, since it connects to the smart app, I can check for low salt levels, drum sterilization, and even change the shutdown melody, which is sometimes fun. These little joys are what make a kitchen unique. Since this is my first time using a dishwasher, I had really high expectations. My husband and I used to fight a lot over washing dishes, but now we live in a convenient world where that is no longer necessary. Of course, there are still many things that require human hands, but thanks to the machine, it is very convenient. Please do not hesitate to purchase one. Thank you. -----------------------------------------------------------------. If my review was helpful, please give it a 'Helpful'. -----------------------------------------------------------------

There is a screwdriver slot in the front middle that allows you to adjust the back portion of the base of the dishwasher. I am so far pleased with this appliance after a month of use. Would recommend.

I was trying to buy it in a hurry, but the price was not easy. Then, luckily, Naver's strong sale started, so I bought it at a good price. It took a week from purchase to installation. I think it was inevitable because there were many buyers during the sale period. The waiting time was very exciting. Maybe because I'm old, I waited knowing that a happy call would come, but these days, they all notify me of the progress via KakaoTalk text message before the day of installation. And a week later, my house was old, but I used a standard cabinet, so the remodeling and installation were done on the same day. The remodeling technician came first and kindly reinforced the countertop and cut the mop holder well. After that, two installation technicians finally brought the new dishwasher and worked hard for about 40 minutes. The installation technicians also re-attached the door under the sink and repaired and organized the pipes better. Thanks to the kind service of the Samsung service technicians, I felt much better even before using it. I was washing dishes by hand for a week and realized how much the dishwasher improved our quality of life. The Samsung dishwasher that I worked hard for 15 years was like the Going Mary. I was grateful for the old dishwasher that had reached the end of its lifespan, but I won't miss it. Let's stay together for the next 20 years with the new DW60DB701W01! Oh, and since you also told me how to connect to Smart Sync, it would be good to remember the name of the router Wi-Fi in the living room or near the dishwasher. I was in a hurry so I connected to the Wi-Fi in my room, but the internet connection was not good so it would take some time, so I think it would be good to prepare it in advance so that you don't panic like me. I'll see you again in a month's review to see how well it works and how good it is. ^^

I was trying to buy it in a hurry, but the price was not easy. Then, luckily, Naver's strong sale started, so I bought it at a good price. It took a week from purchase to installation. I think it was inevitable because there were many buyers during the sale period. The waiting time was very exciting. Maybe because I'm old, I waited knowing that a happy call would come, but these days, they all notify me of the progress via KakaoTalk text message before the day of installation. And a week later, my house was old, but I used a standard cabinet, so the remodeling and installation were done on the same day. The remodeling technician came first and kindly reinforced the countertop and cut the mop holder well. After that, two installation technicians finally brought the new dishwasher and worked hard for about 40 minutes. The installation technicians also re-attached the door under the sink and repaired and organized the pipes better. Thanks to the kind service of the Samsung service technicians, I felt much better even before using it. I was washing dishes by hand for a week and realized how much the dishwasher improved our quality of life. The Samsung dishwasher that I worked hard for 15 years was like the Going Mary. I was grateful for the old dishwasher that had reached the end of its lifespan, but I won't miss it. Let's stay together for the next 20 years with the new DW60DB701W01! Oh, and since you also told me how to connect to Smart Sync, it would be good to remember the name of the router Wi-Fi in the living room or near the dishwasher. I was in a hurry so I connected to the Wi-Fi in my room, but the internet connection was not good so it would take some time, so I think it would be good to prepare it in advance so that you don't panic like me. I'll see you again in a month's review to see how well it works and how good it is. ^^

Sentence (English): After 18 years with a dishwasher of a similar range, the leap in quality is evident.
Comments (English): [ A leap in quality and technology ] || ---------------- || After 18 years with a dishwasher of a similar range, the leap in quality is evident. It still fulfils its main function but does it better (effectiveness), with lower energy costs (efficiency) and with more silence (convenience). Among the aspects that have surprised me the most is the "Home connect" application and its management of programming and energy savings (very useful for those of us who have an electricity tariff with time discrimination). It was a surprise (which I will try) that new programs can be "downloaded" to the dishwasher, opening up the range of options beyond the "usual" ones. I was a little surprised (I have to try it more) with the duration of the ECO program (longer than what I had read), although it is true that it is two hours of activity and the rest is drying and opening the door. To put a but to the interior design, when having the cutlery tray loaded it is almost impossible to put small plates in the upper one and large ones in the lower one, or one thing or the other. And it is a question of millimetres (in my dishes, of course). In short, a good dishwasher whose higher cost (due to the energy class) is amortized over the expected useful life of the appliance.
Comments (Original): [ Un salto de calidad y tecnológico ] || ---------------- || Tras 18 años con un lavavajillas de gama similar, el salto de calidad es evidente. Sigue cumpliendo su función principal pero lo hace mejor (eficacia), con menor coste energético (eficiencia) y con más silencio (comodidad).Entre los aspectos que más me han sorprendido es la aplicación 'Home connect' y su gestión de la programación y del ahorro energético (muy útil para quienn tenemos una tarifa de la luz con discriminación horaria). Ha sido una sorpresa (que probaré) que se puedan 'descargar' nuevos programas al lavavajillas, abriendo el abanico de opciones más allá de los 'habituales'.Un poco extrañado (tengo que probarlo más) con la duración del programa ECO (mayor que lo que había leído), aunque es cierto que son dos horas de actividad y el resto secado y apertura de puerta.Por ponerle un pero al diseño interior, al tener cargada la bandeja de cubiertos es casi imposible poner platos pequeños en la superior y grandes en la inferior, o una cosa u otra. Y es una cuestión de milímetros (en mi vajilla, claro).En resumen, un buen lavajajillas cuyo coste superior (por la clase energética) se amortiza en la vida útil esperada del aparato.

Comments (English): [ Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || One-line summary: Chosen as a beginner dishwasher for the first time! It is built-in, so it matches the kitchen naturally and gives a clean feeling. The shimmer charcoal color is luxurious and goes well with any kitchen. Capacity & Internal Structure It is spacious enough for a large family to use since it can accommodate 14 people. You can put dishes of various sizes in the height-adjustable basket. Suitable for large families and those who cook frequently. Hot air drying + automatic door opening function Excellent drying effect. Height-adjustable basket & spoon-only compartment Convenient tableware arrangement. Good cleaning power, good grease removal effect. It is not noisy, so it can be used at night. Cons Sometimes water stains remain more than expected. Requires use of rinse aid. Plastic containers are more likely to have water droplets left after drying. Recommended for these people! Sentence (English): Among the 14-person LG dishwashers, this is the model with a 10cm mop holder, so I bought this.
Comments (English): Among the 14-person LG dishwashers, this is the model with a 10cm mop holder, so I bought this. Until 4 years ago, I used an S Magic 6-person dishwasher that was placed on top of the sink when I was a family of 3, but the space was too narrow to put the dishes and pots and pans that were used after cooking for the family at dinner in the 6-person dishwasher. So I washed the large pots separately by hand and only put the dishes in the dishwasher. Later, it was difficult to play Tetris in the cramped 6-person dishwasher, so I washed all the dishes by hand and the dishwasher was relegated to just being used as a dish rack after washing the dishes. Then I got rid of it and stopped using the dishwasher and just washed the dishes by hand. This year, my second child was born, and I was busy taking care of my newborn second child and taking my first child, who is in first grade, to school and pick-up from school. I didn't have time or energy to wash the dishes, and my wrists hurt too much. My husband tells me not to wash the dishes during the day and to save them since he will do the dishes after dinner, but if I save everything from breakfast, baby food, dinner, etc., they really pile up in the sink, but I can't stand seeing them pile up, so I have to do them right away. So even though I'm busy, I make time to wash the dishes. I wash my hands and use detergent so many times a day to take care of the baby, and now I have housewife's eczema and an unknown skin disease on the back of my hands. If I wear rubber gloves, it gets worse because of the moisture. My caring husband always volunteers to do the dishes without complaint, but since he's tied up in the kitchen for almost an hour to do the dishes, I have to take care of the kids. I have to help my first grader with his homework and take care of my second newborn. Dinner time flies by in a flash, and it's the golden time of the day when the whole family gathers, but the time that all four of us can spend together is reduced due to washing dishes, so I thought I absolutely had to get a dishwasher, so I started looking into dishwashers around fall. I compared LG's and Sam's with similar specs and a 10cm mop holder, and the big features are that Sam's has a water filter and it's not made in Korea, LG's has the advantage of a True Steam function, and unlike Sam's, you have to add salt and it's made in Korea. 10 years ago, when I got married, I learned that white goods should definitely be LG, so I bought all of the wedding appliances from LG, but the TV, washing machine, and refrigerator all had defects so I had to get after-sales service. 4 years ago, when I moved into my current home, I installed an LG system air conditioner as an option when it was sold (not a custom-made one), but due to a defective drain pump, water leaked, and one night while I was sleeping, water leaking from the system air conditioner attached to the ceiling hit my head. 2 years ago, although I really didn't want to pay for another LG product, I bought an 86-inch LG TV based on the common sense(?) that I should definitely buy an LG TV. This summer, 2 years later, the motherboard suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to pay over 200,000 won for repairs and after-sales service. To that extent, my family has had more than one or two headaches with LG appliances, to the point that we're currently replacing all of our appliances with new ones. I was worried that it would break down again when I brought in an LG dishwasher. Nevertheless, I chose the LG dishwasher because it's manufactured in Korea. We can use the Sam* employee mall, and since we are related to Sam* employees, we could have bought a Sam* dishwasher with the same specs as this model for about 300,000 won cheaper, but we decided on this LG model because we thought better is better. After deciding to purchase this model, we watched the price trend starting in the fall, and the price on Coupang fluctuated significantly within a day or two. After watching, we bought it on the day the price suddenly dropped. An LG technician came and did the delivery/installation. Since the sink in my house is a 600-size standard, we could just separate the storage cabinets, but we had to cut out the mop holder and reinforce the inner support, so we spent an additional 80,000 won in labor costs. Since I had used a 6-person dishwasher until a few years ago, I know everything about dish Tetris and larval washing, so I have no inconveniences in using it. The Tetris of the dishes is something you get used to using it, and for the pre-washing, after you finish eating, collect the food, wash it with water, and then soak it in a large bowl filled with water. This way, you can remove some of the food without having to use a scrubber. Comments (English): Among the 14-person LG dishwashers, this is the model with a 10cm mop holder, so I bought this. Until 4 years ago, I used an S Magic 6-person dishwasher that was placed on top of the sink when I was a family of 3, but the space was too narrow to put the dishes and pots and pans that were used after cooking for the family at dinner in the 6-person dishwasher. So I washed the large pots separately by hand and only put the dishes in the dishwasher. Later, it was difficult to play Tetris in the cramped 6-person dishwasher, so I washed all the dishes by hand and the dishwasher was relegated to just being used as a dish rack after washing the dishes. Then I got rid of it and stopped using the dishwasher and just washed the dishes by hand. I didn't have time or energy to wash the dishes, and my wrists hurt too much. So even though I'm busy, I make time to wash the dishes. I wash my hands and use detergent so many times a day to take care of the baby, and now I have housewife's eczema and an unknown skin disease on the back of my hands. If I wear rubber gloves, it gets worse because of the moisture. My caring husband always volunteers to do the dishes without complaint, but since he's tied up in the kitchen for almost an hour to do the dishes, I have to take care of the kids. I have to help my first grader with his homework and take care of my second newborn. This summer, 2 years later, the motherboard suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to pay over 200,000 won for repairs and after-sales service. To that extent, my family has had more than one or two headaches with LG appliances, to the point that we're currently replacing all of our appliances with new ones. I was worried that it would break down again when I brought in an LG dishwasher. Nevertheless, I chose the LG dishwasher because it's manufactured in Korea. We can use the Sam* employee mall, and since we are related to Sam* employees, we could have bought a Sam* dishwasher with the same specs as this model for about 300,000 won cheaper, but we decided on this LG model because we thought better is better. After deciding to purchase this model, we watched the price trend starting in the fall, and the price on Coupang fluctuated significantly within a day or two. After watching, we bought it on the day the price suddenly dropped. An LG technician came and did the delivery/installation. Since the sink in my house is a 600-size standard, we could just separate the storage cabinets, but we had to cut out the mop holder and reinforce the inner support, so we spent an additional 80,000 won in labor costs. Since I had used a 6-person dishwasher until a few years ago, I know everything about dish Tetris and larval washing, so I have no inconveniences in using it. The Tetris of the dishes is something you get used to using it, and for the pre-washing, after you finish eating, collect the food, wash it with water, and then soak it in a large bowl filled with water. This way, you can remove some of the food without having to use a scrubber. It is definitely much wider than the 6-person dishwasher I used before, so there is no stress about Tetris of putting dishes in the narrow dishwasher. Because the space is wide, you can just put them in. The exterior size is the same as the old 12-person model with 2 baskets, but this 14-person model has 3 baskets, so there is more storage for dishes. The downside is that it is more comfortable than washing dishes by hand, but the electricity bill is high, and you have to bend down to put the dishes in. However, if you use it, your quality of life will change, so I recommend it to those who are considering buying it. Buy it as soon as possible and be free from washing dishes!

Until 4 years ago, I used an S Magic 6-person dishwasher that was placed on top of the sink when I was a family of 3, but the space was too narrow to put the dishes and pots and pans that were used after cooking for the family at dinner in the 6-person dishwasher. Later, it was difficult to play Tetris in the cramped 6-person dishwasher, so I washed all the dishes by hand and the dishwasher was relegated to just being used as a dish rack after washing the dishes. Then I got rid of it and stopped using the dishwasher and just washed the dishes by hand. This year, my second child was born, and I was busy taking care of my newborn second child and taking my first child, who is in first grade, to school and pick-up from school. I didn't have time or energy to wash the dishes, and my wrists hurt too much. My husband tells me not to wash the dishes during the day and to save them since he will do the dishes after dinner, but if I save everything from breakfast, baby food, dinner, etc., they really pile up in the sink, but I can't stand seeing them pile up, so I have to do them right away. So even though I'm busy, I make time to wash the dishes. I wash my hands and use detergent so many times a day to take care of the baby, and now I have housewife's eczema and an unknown skin disease on the back of my hands. If I wear rubber gloves, it gets worse because of the moisture. My caring husband always volunteers to do the dishes without complaint, but since he's tied up in the kitchen for almost an hour to do the dishes, I have to take care of the kids. I have to help my first grader with his homework and take care of my second newborn. After deciding to purchase this model, we watched the price trend starting in the fall, and the price on Coupang fluctuated significantly within a day or two. Since the sink in my house is a 600-size standard, we could just separate the storage cabinets, but we had to cut out the mop holder and reinforce the inner support, so we spent an additional 80,000 won in labor costs. Since I had used a 6-person dishwasher until a few years ago, I know everything about dish Tetris and larval washing, so I have no inconveniences in using it. Comments (English): Among the 14-person LG dishwashers, this is the model with a 10cm mop holder, so I bought this. Until 4 years ago, I used an S Magic 6-person dishwasher that was placed on top of the sink when I was a family of 3, but the space was too narrow to put the dishes and pots and pans that were used after cooking for the family at dinner in the 6-person dishwasher. So I washed the large pots separately by hand and only put the dishes in the dishwasher. Later, it was difficult to play Tetris in the cramped 6-person dishwasher, so I washed all the dishes by hand and the dishwasher was relegated to just being used as a dish rack after washing the dishes. Then I got rid of it and stopped using the dishwasher and just washed the dishes by hand. This year, my second child was born, and I was busy taking care of my newborn second child and taking my first child, who is in first grade, to school and pick-up from school. I didn't have time or energy to wash the dishes, and my wrists hurt too much. My husband tells me not to wash the dishes during the day and to save them since he will do the dishes after dinner, but if I save everything from breakfast, baby food, dinner, etc., they really pile up in the sink, but I can't stand seeing them pile up, so I have to do them right away. So even though I'm busy, I make time to wash the dishes. I wash my hands and use detergent so many times a day to take care of the baby, and now I have housewife's eczema and an unknown skin disease on the back of my hands. If I wear rubber gloves, it gets worse because of the moisture. My caring husband always volunteers to do the dishes without complaint, but since he's tied up in the kitchen for almost an hour to do the dishes, I have to take care of the kids. I have to help my first grader with his homework and take care of my second newborn. Dinner time flies by in a flash, and it's the golden time of the day when the whole family gathers, but the time that all four of us can spend together is reduced due to washing dishes, so I thought I absolutely had to get a dishwasher, so I started looking into dishwashers around fall. I compared LG's and Sam's with similar specs and a 10cm mop holder, and the big features are that Sam's has a water filter and it's not made in Korea, LG's has the advantage of a True Steam function, and unlike Sam's, you have to add salt and it's made in Korea. 10 years ago, when I got married, I learned that white goods should definitely be LG, so I bought all of the wedding appliances from LG, but the TV, washing machine, and refrigerator all had defects so I had to get after-sales service. 4 years ago, when I moved into my current home, I installed an LG system air conditioner as an option when it was sold (not a custom-made one), but due to a defective drain pump, water leaked, and one night while I was sleeping, water leaking from the system air conditioner attached to the ceiling hit my head. 2 years ago, although I really didn't want to pay for another LG product, I bought an 86-inch LG TV based on the common sense(?) that I should definitely buy an LG TV. This summer, 2 years later, the motherboard suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to pay over 200,000 won for repairs and after-sales service. To that extent, my family has had more than one or two headaches with LG appliances, to the point that we're currently replacing all of our appliances with new ones. I was worried that it would break down again when I brought in an LG dishwasher. Nevertheless, I chose the LG dishwasher because it's manufactured in Korea. We can use the Sam* employee mall, and since we are related to Sam* employees, we could have bought a Sam* dishwasher with the same specs as this model for about 300,000 won cheaper, but we decided on this LG model because we thought better is better. After deciding to purchase this model, we watched the price trend starting in the fall, and the price on Coupang fluctuated significantly within a day or two. After watching, we bought it on the day the price suddenly dropped. An LG technician came and did the delivery/installation. Since the sink in my house is a 600-size standard, we could just separate the storage cabinets, but we had to cut out the mop holder and reinforce the inner support, so we spent an additional 80,000 won in labor costs. Since I had used a 6-person dishwasher until a few years ago, I know everything about dish Tetris and larval washing, so I have no inconveniences in using it. The Tetris of the dishes is something you get used to using it, and for the pre-washing, after you finish eating, collect the food, wash it with water, and then soak it in a large bowl filled with water. This way, you can remove some of the food without having to use a scrubber. It is definitely much wider than the 6-person dishwasher I used before, so there is no stress about Tetris of putting dishes in the narrow dishwasher. Because the space is wide, you can just put them in. The exterior size is the same as the old 12-person model with 2 baskets, but this 14-person model has 3 baskets, so there is more storage for dishes. The downside is that it is more comfortable than washing dishes by hand, but the electricity bill is high, and you have to bend down to put the dishes in. However, if you use it, your quality of life will change, so I recommend it to those who are considering buying it. Buy it as soon as possible and be free from washing dishes!
