After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. The technician contacted me the very next day to schedule the installation, and it was installed the day after purchase. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Sentence (English): It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing.
Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. However, I desperately wanted to use it but felt I had my limits, so I decided to take the plunge. I am very satisfied, so I am leaving this review. First, let me explain my home situation: - We are renting a 25-pyeong apartment, which makes built-in appliances difficult. - Due to the unique structure of our kitchen, Samsung and LG 6-person models were unsuitable for installation. (For reasons such as drainage lines passing through the induction cooktop even though there were pre-drilled holes, the cooktop could not be placed within 30cm of the burner, and the size was unsuitable for placing right next to the sink.) I purchased this product because it claimed to be drill-free and could be installed next to an induction cooktop or burner. The technician contacted me the very next day to schedule the installation, and it was installed the day after purchase. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. However, I desperately wanted to use it but felt I had my limits, so I decided to take the plunge. I am very satisfied, so I am leaving this review. First, let me explain my home situation: - We are renting a 25-pyeong apartment, which makes built-in appliances difficult. - Due to the unique structure of our kitchen, Samsung and LG 6-person models were unsuitable for installation. (For reasons such as drainage lines passing through the induction cooktop even though there were pre-drilled holes, the cooktop could not be placed within 30cm of the burner, and the size was unsuitable for placing right next to the sink.) I purchased this product because it claimed to be drill-free and could be installed next to an induction cooktop or burner. The technician contacted me the very next day to schedule the installation, and it was installed the day after purchase. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. However, I desperately wanted to use it but felt I had my limits, so I decided to take the plunge. I am very satisfied, so I am leaving this review. First, let me explain my home situation: - We are renting a 25-pyeong apartment, which makes built-in appliances difficult. - Due to the unique structure of our kitchen, Samsung and LG 6-person models were unsuitable for installation. (For reasons such as drainage lines passing through the induction cooktop even though there were pre-drilled holes, the cooktop could not be placed within 30cm of the burner, and the size was unsuitable for placing right next to the sink.) I purchased this product because it claimed to be drill-free and could be installed next to an induction cooktop or burner. The technician contacted me the very next day to schedule the installation, and it was installed the day after purchase. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were hardly any reviews from people who bought this with their own money. However, I desperately wanted to use it but felt I had my limits, so I decided to take the plunge. I am very satisfied, so I am leaving this review. First, let me explain my home situation: - We are renting a 25-pyeong apartment, which makes built-in appliances difficult. - Due to the unique structure of our kitchen, Samsung and LG 6-person models were unsuitable for installation. (For reasons such as drainage lines passing through the induction cooktop even though there were pre-drilled holes, the cooktop could not be placed within 30cm of the burner, and the size was unsuitable for placing right next to the sink.) I purchased this product because it claimed to be drill-free and could be installed next to an induction cooktop or burner. The technician contacted me the very next day to schedule the installation, and it was installed the day after purchase. Although the technician initially seemed to struggle with our narrow and unique kitchen layout, he kindly helped me think it through, which is another aspect I am satisfied with. With the birth of my child approaching, I felt burdened by dishwashing, so I reluctantly decided to buy at least a 6-person model, but I am much more satisfied than I expected. It is very easy to set up and is perfect for washing up leftovers from breakfast and dinner for a two-person household. My tendency to be bad at stacking might play a part, though. After using it for about three weeks, I find that since I tend to use a frying pan for meat or fried food for every meal and also use a pot occasionally, if I include the frying pan and pot, I think it can only handle about one meal. When I run it once a day, I exclude wooden tableware, frying pans, and pots. When I include pots and frying pans, I wash up a single meal. The button operation is also very simple. You just turn on the power (since there is a default mode) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything squeaky clean. It worked perfectly on the frying pan used to grill LA galbi and even on the plate with the red grease left over from spicy chicken stew. You can also run additional rinse and wash functions, but I haven't used them yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and since I think elderly people would find it easy to use, I am seriously considering buying one for my mom. However, for households of 3 or more, the 6-person size is too small, so I recommend the 12-14 person size. I recommend it for families of 1-2 people plus a baby, homes that cannot be built-in, or homes that do not require drilling holes. Regarding high-temperature drying, it is initially confusing because there is no separate drying function. If you pre-wash with water just once before putting them in, it cleans thoroughly, removing even grease stains, leaving both the inside and outside squeaky clean. However, some water does pool in the concave areas on the back of dishes where they are turned upside down. But since there is an automatic door opening function, if you run it after dinner and check the next morning, there are usually only a drop or two of water remaining in the concave areas on the back. We actually dislike even that, so we take them out to the sink to dry completely once they are done, but it is not inconvenient at all; in fact, I feel good about the squeaky-clean dishes! For reference, in our house, we cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape and it only opens about 45 degrees because it gets caught on the faucet, but we are still satisfied with it. You just need to stack the first layer first, then assemble and fill the second layer. It might look a bit inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are so satisfying that I hope those who need this for a kitchen with a unique layout like ours will take it into consideration when purchasing. If you have a larger kitchen, it unfolds completely into a straight L shape, making it much easier to use, so I recommend it. For reference, since ours is right next to the sink, we didn't need to drill a separate hole; we just ran the drain pipe directly to the sink and installed the water supply along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance as well. Since Coupang handles after-sales service, I plan to use it comfortably. Above all, the price is half that of other brands, so I am very satisfied with it considering the cost!

Sentence (English): I love the option to sanitize, the bottle jets, and silverware jets (Finally someone put this in for me! ).
Comments (English): [ Amazing - so many features, quite, well worth it! ] || ---------------- || I love the option to sanitize, the bottle jets, and silverware jets (Finally someone put this in for me! ). My previous dishwasher also had the 3 shelves like this one does, however I was use to being able to put my mugs in that top shelf and it washed them, I had significantly more room to put a few taller "delicate" items in. (I had my old machine for 4-5 years, I was very comfortable with it making little changes seem like big obstacles! The top shelf does do wonders for the utensils that need some extra spraying off, I like that it has the side with the spray area. The middle shelf is adjustable, it has 2 height settings, It would be nice if it had 3, so you could put it in the middle and be able to have some kid plates or plasticware lids and be able to shut the shelf without it getting caught on the top shelf. I use small (6"x6") square plastic plates for the kids and if I have those loaded in and the shelf is on the highest setting the plates won't allow the shelf to go all the way in without getting caught on the top shelf. If this shelf is lowered all the way the spray arm on the underside of the shelf will get caught on the utensils in the basket on the bottom shelf. I figured out that I can't use the little slots to hold our regular forks/spoons/knives, they are too tall they have to be strategically placed in the two compartments on the ends with the little lid thing left open. You have to put them in so that they are leaning from one side of the basket to the other if that makes any sense at all, they just cannot be standing straight up. The kids plastic utensils fit just fine and do not interfere with the spray arm spinning. The bottle jets are AMAZING! The week after we installed this unit our family was hit with a round of a nasty cold. I was great to be able to wash the kids water bottles on sanitize and have them sprayed out with individual targeted jets. That was so wonderful! Having those jets also works great for those bottles or containers that you cant fit the dish brush in to get the bottom corners cleaned efficiently.The bottom shelf is very versatile, and I like it quite a bit. There are two rows of plate holders or dividers, whatever they are called. One side you can fold down to fit bigger pots and pans in, which comes in very handy and allows you to fit a little more in without having to fandangle everything and still not get all the dishes to fit in. One downfall of this is when you have the side folded down the other set of plate dividers causes the plates to lay/lean over on top of one another, I feel like they don't get as clean that way but I could be very wrong. The set of dividers that lays down, when locked in place, they will hold the plates nicely in one place so they don't lean at all. Now the utensils, the basket sits on its own set of jets. I have said for years that I wished there was something there to rinse those a little extra, and now I have it! This dishwasher also has the Wi-Fi capabilities. I was hesitant at first but once I found the lock feature I was sold. We have a 3 1/2 year old that loves to push buttons and he was really good at stopping my old dishwasher about half way through. With this I can lock it with my phone and he can't interfere with my wash cycles! I can also go in and customize my washes; turning on/off the bottle jets, utensil jets, water temp, drying, steam, etc. There are so many features I have not discovered yet, this is definitely worth it, hands down the best dishwasher we've had thus far. Another thing, it is quiet. I have got it ready to go and waited to turn it on until later on and I have went back to the kitchen to make sure it was going.

The week after we installed this unit our family was hit with a round of a nasty cold. I figured out that I can't use the little slots to hold our regular forks/spoons/knives, they are too tall they have to be strategically placed in the two compartments on the ends with the little lid thing left open.  You have to put them in so that they are leaning from one side of the basket to the other if that makes any sense at all, they just cannot be standing straight up.  The kids plastic utensils fit just fine and do not interfere with the spray arm spinning.  The bottle jets are AMAZING!!!  The week after we installed this unit our family was hit with a round of a nasty cold.  I was great to be able to wash the kids water bottles on sanitize and have them sprayed out with individual targeted jets. That was so wonderful!!  Having those jets also works great for those bottles or containers that you cant fit the dish brush in to get the bottom corners cleaned efficiently.The bottom shelf is very versatile, and I like it quite a bit. There are two rows of plate holders or dividers, whatever they are called.  One side you can fold down to fit bigger pots and pans in, which comes in very handy and allows you to fit a little more in without having to fandangle everything and still not get all the dishes to fit in.  One downfall of this is when you have the side folded down the other set of plate dividers causes the plates to lay/lean over on top of one another, I feel like they don't get as clean that way but I could be very wrong.  The set of dividers that lays down, when locked in place, they will hold the plates nicely in one place so they don't lean at all. Now the utensils, the basket sits on its own set of jets.  I have said for years that I wished there was something there to rinse those a little extra, and now I have it!!  This dishwasher also has the Wi-Fi capabilities.  I was hesitant at first but once I found the lock feature I was sold.  We have a 3 1/2 year old that loves to push buttons and he was really good at stopping my old dishwasher about half way through.  With this I can lock it with my phone and he can't interfere with my wash cycles!  I can also go in and customize my washes; turning on/off the bottle jets, utensil jets, water temp, drying, steam, etc... There are so many features I have not discovered yet, this is definitely worth it, hands down the best dishwasher we've had thus far.  Another thing, it is quiet.  I have got it ready to go and waited to turn it on until later on and I have went back to the kitchen to make sure it was going.

Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher. App & stemw holder not so much ] || ---------------- || Cleaning - very good. Baked on stuff came off well in both the Auto cycle and the Speed60 cycle. Lip marks are gone from glasses. With the PowerControl zone washing arm, burnt-on stuff and even the starch film in rice pots are well taken care of. The Speed60 completed in 65 minutes so I guess YMMV but that's pretty speedy for a modern dishwasher. Third Rack - I'm new to this feature and had my doubts about how water would reach all parts of the rack. It has worked better than I expected, but the few times I've seen schmutz after a load, they have mostly been in the third rack. BTW, if you stack flatware EXACTLY how Bosch wants it done (and the layout is not obvious), they will be very stable and clean. Stack it just the slightest crooked and you'll see a jumble of spoons and forks every time you open the rack. Racks & Tines - many people don't like Bosch's bottom rack, but I've managed to tetris everything in. The machine has so much more room than my previous that I now run a cycle every three days instead of every other day. There appears to be exactly one way to stack anything at any location. (Cue the German/Teutonic jokes.) Bowls and bigger items have some issues, but the numerous foldable tines help. The stemware holder, which also serves as mini-shelf for ramekins, etc, must be folded up to use. This is a bad design. If you've already stacked that row and decide you need the mini-shelf, you have to rearrange everything to flip the shelf up. So I keep it always folded up, but then squeezing things under the shelf, especially if you already have some wine glasses in front, is difficult. Bosch should have stayed with the shelf that stayed out of the way because it folded UP. Drying - Condensation drying actually works! Works even better with rinse aid. And works super well if I open the door right after the full cycle – which was what I did for decades with my old machine to avoid using the heated drying. The third rack, being virtually all plastic, retains the most water droplets. Crystal Dry is marginally better and leaves only a few drops of water on plastics and on the third rack. Quietness - very! But you can hear sloshing if you are close, which is what I want so I can hear if there are any issues inside. Filter – Not too difficult or scary, though the location is slightly awkward. I'm cleaning about every 2-3 weeks and don't see anything alarming. App - Cluttered, confusing, and just as annoying as I feared. Had to juggle Wifi and bluetooth and be close to the machine and restart repeatedly and wait wait wait. The "photo registration" never did work. I had to call in with the long number. NB: If the customer will need a critical serial number, can you please not require them to get flat on the floor and read sideways? If you're going to force customers to use the app for basic operations, can you NOT bury those them under statistics, settings, recipes (? ), and ADS? *(This last one should be a crime.) If something is a "Cycle" on the machine, why is it a "Program" on the app - because everything isn't confusing enough already? What's the difference between “Custom” and “Favorite”? Can you give us clear confirmation of what cycle and options are actually running? I wanted to test the PowerControl arm, but I can never be sure whether I've set the feature on or not. Build and Design – There is some flex on the front panel and handle. Fingerprints still show, but I guess dishwashers have to deal with a lot of dirty fingers. Efficiency – I assume it's water and energy efficient because the app tells me so. But the greatest efficiency is that the machine is so much larger than its replacement, I run it every 3 days instead of 2. I've never been bothered with leaving dirty dishes in the dishwasher for a couple days, but if I did, the handy quick rinse cycle will keep odor at bay until I run the full wash.

I bought it at a very cheap price with the strong sale coupon from Labang. There were many twists and turns from the reform to the delivery, but... The reformer was very thorough and the installers were also kind. Since it is an induction + dishwasher combination, you cannot choose the model you want, but for this combination at this price, I definitely recommend it!

The Miele dishwasher that was installed when I got it was never used for 20 years and was still covered in plastic when I redid the interior. Is that the problem? The size is as expected. It wasn't just not dry enough or completely dry, it was just as wet as before the dishwasher was used. I don't understand why people who leave good reviews here have low expectations. Anyway, I'm really worried. I bought a few tablet-type ones that are supposed to be eco-friendly detergents, but there's no detergent container, so I used it twice on the first day and was disappointed, so I just washed it by hand without putting it in the dishwasher and just used the dryer I had been using. I will try it again and leave an additional review just to check if mine is defective or not.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher accident increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS] Color: Glam White Installation method: Built-in installation Country of manufacture: Thailand Manufacturer/Importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023 [Main functions] Sterilization + drying (not drying with 100 degrees hot air) Automatic door opening function Cleaning performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720-degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / AI customized washing X High-temperature direct water washing included / No water filter X Number of dish baskets 3 EA / No internal lighting ********( . )******* Hello, first of all, I have two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws often eat together. Because of this, there are a lot of dishes to wash, and I have been in dishwashing hell for over 5 years since I got married. In the meantime, I suddenly received a dishwasher and carefully looked into it and compared prices. After worrying about it for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt. I searched YouTube and looked at three famous brands and compared prices every day, and I ended up choosing this product. I also listened to the opinions of mothers around me and compared them. The products with hot air drying systems from various manufacturers were more expensive. The reason I omitted this function was that it was impossible to wash dishes in extremely hot water when washing dishes, and even without the hot air drying system, there is a function that washes and dries at over 75 degrees. My children had already graduated from bottles, and I thought this function was not really necessary, so I decided to match the cost-effectiveness. ( _) So while comparing manufacturers of 12-person products, I saw that this Samsung product was cheaper than the 12-person products of other companies, and if it was 14-person, it could hold 16 more dishes? This information was appealing. I was able to end my worries because of that. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Because it does it for me ( ) However, I thought that it would be okay to choose the dishwashing according to the amount of each day, and since I didn't necessarily need the light after washing the dishes at night, I thought I could just turn it on and look. The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. When comparing, AI is convenient! I find it annoying, it's a waste of electricity to turn on the light at night, and it's more reassuring to wash with purified water. You can compare prices! Also, I have seen reviews that say that it generates heat while drying and may cause a slight smell, but when comparing it to other products, all of them had the same symptoms and I judged that it was the smell of the drying process unique to dishwashers. When I actually used it, I didn't feel much discomfort (because it's not always next to the dishwasher) ()*:.. .:** One of the differences from other companies is that Samsung takes 2 days to install. First, they come to check if the dishwasher can be installed properly, and the next day, the installation technician comes and completes the installation quickly. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (- .) I moved it so that it was convenient to move dishes from the sink by placing it next to the sink. Of course, it cost extra, but I planned to use it for a long time and expected that I would be concerned every day if I didn't do this. As a result, I am satisfied and it is convenient to put the dishes in after collecting them and removing food residues after disposing of them. When comparing models, I thought that there was a drying function, but in the previous review, why was there so much moisture? Here's the result of my own use after thinking about it. If you don't use the separate strong drying function after washing in standard mode, there will be a lot of moisture as shown in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there will be almost no moisture! () I'm so happy to have finally escaped dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher when you consider the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying. There's a lot more I could explain, but this has become too long, so I'll stop here. I am very satisfied with this product and I am using it. I hope my review was helpful! The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! The products with hot air drying systems from various manufacturers were more expensive. ( _) So while comparing manufacturers of 12-person products, I saw that this Samsung product was cheaper than the 12-person products of other companies, and if it was 14-person, it could hold 16 more dishes? This information was appealing. I was able to end my worries because of that. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Because it does it for me ( ) However, I thought that it would be okay to choose the dishwashing according to the amount of each day, and since I didn't necessarily need the light after washing the dishes at night, I thought I could just turn it on and look. The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. When comparing, AI is convenient! I find it annoying, it's a waste of electricity to turn on the light at night, and it's more reassuring to wash with purified water. You can compare prices! Also, I have seen reviews that say that it generates heat while drying and may cause a slight smell, but when comparing it to other products, all of them had the same symptoms and I judged that it was the smell of the drying process unique to dishwashers. When I actually used it, I didn't feel much discomfort (because it's not always next to the dishwasher) ()*:.. .:** One of the differences from other companies is that Samsung takes 2 days to install. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (- .) I moved it so that it was convenient to move dishes from the sink by placing it next to the sink. Of course, it cost extra, but I planned to use it for a long time and expected that I would be concerned every day if I didn't do this. As a result, I am satisfied and it is convenient to put the dishes in after collecting them and removing food residues after disposing of them. When comparing models, I thought that there was a drying function, but in the previous review, why was there so much moisture? Here's the result of my own use after thinking about it. If you don't use the separate strong drying function after washing in standard mode, there will be a lot of moisture as shown in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there will be almost no moisture! () I'm so happy to have finally escaped dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher when you consider the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying. Because of this, there are a lot of dishes to wash, and I have been in dishwashing hell for over 5 years since I got married. In the meantime, I suddenly received a dishwasher and carefully looked into it and compared prices. After worrying about it for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt. I searched YouTube and looked at three famous brands and compared prices every day, and I ended up choosing this product. I also listened to the opinions of mothers around me and compared them. The products with hot air drying systems from various manufacturers were more expensive. The reason I omitted this function was that it was impossible to wash dishes in extremely hot water when washing dishes, and even without the hot air drying system, there is a function that washes and dries at over 75 degrees. My children had already graduated from bottles, and I thought this function was not really necessary, so I decided to match the cost-effectiveness. ( _) So while comparing manufacturers of 12-person products, I saw that this Samsung product was cheaper than the 12-person products of other companies, and if it was 14-person, it could hold 16 more dishes? This information was appealing. I was able to end my worries because of that. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Because it does it for me ( ) However, I thought that it would be okay to choose the dishwashing according to the amount of each day, and since I didn't necessarily need the light after washing the dishes at night, I thought I could just turn it on and look. The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. When comparing, AI is convenient! I find it annoying, it's a waste of electricity to turn on the light at night, and it's more reassuring to wash with purified water. You can compare prices! Also, I have seen reviews that say that it generates heat while drying and may cause a slight smell, but when comparing it to other products, all of them had the same symptoms and I judged that it was the smell of the drying process unique to dishwashers. When I actually used it, I didn't feel much discomfort (because it's not always next to the dishwasher) ()*:.. .:** One of the differences from other companies is that Samsung takes 2 days to install. First, they come to check if the dishwasher can be installed properly, and the next day, the installation technician comes and completes the installation quickly. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (- .) I moved it so that it was convenient to move dishes from the sink by placing it next to the sink. Of course, it cost extra, but I planned to use it for a long time and expected that I would be concerned every day if I didn't do this. As a result, I am satisfied and it is convenient to put the dishes in after collecting them and removing food residues after disposing of them. When comparing models, I thought that there was a drying function, but in the previous review, why was there so much moisture? Here's the result of my own use after thinking about it. If you don't use the separate strong drying function after washing in standard mode, there will be a lot of moisture as shown in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there will be almost no moisture! () I'm so happy to have finally escaped dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher when you consider the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying. There's a lot more I could explain, but this has become too long, so I'll stop here. I am very satisfied with this product and I am using it. I hope my review was helpful! The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. The products with hot air drying systems from various manufacturers were more expensive. The reason I omitted this function was that it was impossible to wash dishes in extremely hot water when washing dishes, and even without the hot air drying system, there is a function that washes and dries at over 75 degrees. This information was appealing. I was able to end my worries because of that. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Because it does it for me ( ) However, I thought that it would be okay to choose the dishwashing according to the amount of each day, and since I didn't necessarily need the light after washing the dishes at night, I thought I could just turn it on and look. The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. When comparing, AI is convenient! I find it annoying, it's a waste of electricity to turn on the light at night, and it's more reassuring to wash with purified water. You can compare prices! Also, I have seen reviews that say that it generates heat while drying and may cause a slight smell, but when comparing it to other products, all of them had the same symptoms and I judged that it was the smell of the drying process unique to dishwashers. When I actually used it, I didn't feel much discomfort (because it's not always next to the dishwasher) ()*:.. .:** One of the differences from other companies is that Samsung takes 2 days to install. First, they come to check if the dishwasher can be installed properly, and the next day, the installation technician comes and completes the installation quickly. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (- .) I moved it so that it was convenient to move dishes from the sink by placing it next to the sink. Of course, it cost extra, but I planned to use it for a long time and expected that I would be concerned every day if I didn't do this. As a result, I am satisfied and it is convenient to put the dishes in after collecting them and removing food residues after disposing of them. When comparing models, I thought that there was a drying function, but in the previous review, why was there so much moisture? Here's the result of my own use after thinking about it. If you don't use the separate strong drying function after washing in standard mode, there will be a lot of moisture as shown in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there will be almost no moisture! () I'm so happy to have finally escaped dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher when you consider the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. This information was appealing. I was able to end my worries because of that. The product was a January 23 model that was not released long ago, and I compared the performance of the 14-person product. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Because it does it for me ( ) However, I thought that it would be okay to choose the dishwashing according to the amount of each day, and since I didn't necessarily need the light after washing the dishes at night, I thought I could just turn it on and look. The function of washing with purified water. Since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, I decided that it was okay because my house doesn't have groundwater. Of course, it cost extra, but I planned to use it for a long time and expected that I would be concerned every day if I didn't do this. As a result, I am satisfied and it is convenient to put the dishes in after collecting them and removing food residues after disposing of them. When comparing models, I thought that there was a drying function, but in the previous review, why was there so much moisture? Here's the result of my own use after thinking about it. If you don't use the separate strong drying function after washing in standard mode, there will be a lot of moisture as shown in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there will be almost no moisture! () I'm so happy to have finally escaped dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher when you consider the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying. The main features upgraded in the 14-person product were AI mode and the internal lighting needed at night! And I confirmed the difference in the function of filtering once with purified water and cleaning. I decided that these three items would be fine without it. I use a Samsung washing machine/dryer, and I use the AI function in the dryer very usefully. First of all, it can reduce my thoughts! Sentence (English): This is a review of the Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher 14-person Glamping Pink.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that changes the kitchen atmosphere ] || ---------------- || This is a review of the Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher 14-person Glamping Pink. It has a generous capacity for 14 people and is quiet with a night cycle. High-temperature direct water washing means no need to worry about plastic deformation. One dishwasher can change the atmosphere of your kitchen. A technician called me the day before the dishwasher installation, made an appointment, and visited. He removed the drawer under the sink and constructed the lower cabinet to fit the size of the dishwasher. The next day, two dishwasher installation technicians came and completed the installation. The lower cabinet construction took a little over two hours and the dishwasher installation took about thirty minutes. Please note that you may need a multi-tap depending on the electrical situation in your kitchen! It's a built-in type and the glam pink color is so pretty. It's not tacky but luxurious and the subtle pink color really brings the kitchen atmosphere to life. It gives a new interior feel. It's for 14 people so it's perfect for a 4-person household. A lot of dishes come out when you cook one meal, but the dishwasher is large so it all fits. The upper and middle racks move up and down so you can adjust them depending on the type of dishware, which is convenient. Since it's high-temperature direct water, it's said that there's no plastic deformation, so I've included a plastic container. There's a night cycle function so you don't have to worry about noise if you have to run the dishwasher late at night. In addition to the night cycle, you can set it to whatever you want, such as a strong course, steam soaking, high-temperature sterilization, strong drying, and additional rinse. When washing oily dishes, it's clean if you run it with a strong course, high-temperature sterilization, and additional rinse. There is also the advantage of being able to change the panel after a few years. When you want to change the kitchen atmosphere while using it, you can just buy a new panel. I use solid detergent. When there is little dishes, I put in half a solid detergent, and when there is a lot of dishes, I put in one solid detergent, and it washes them just right! I like the capacity of the Samsung Electronics Bespoke Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher Glamping Pink color, and I really like its functions and design! Washing dishes makes my back and knees hurt, and it is difficult. Now, I think a dishwasher is a must-have for my parents' house. It has to be washed by hand at 40 degrees? If you wash it at 80 degrees, I wonder if there will be any oil left. And every time I use a large bowl or a large pot, I worry about washing the dishes, and it takes up too much space on the drying rack, so I mainly cooked rice in small pots and small dishes, but now I just use it! I cook, wash the dishes, cook, wash the dishes, repeat endlessly, and I am so happy that the dishes are all gone. I am not good at Tetris at the dishes because I have not used it for long, so I have to work hard. Pick just one thing that I really regret! If I were to choose, there would have been a separate spoon holder, but it doesn't seem to be fixed, so I feel uneasy about the spoon holder. The three-tiered model had a wide spoon holder on the top, but this isn't there, so I have to use a square spoon holder, but it doesn't seem to be fixed, so that's a little disappointing. But the price was reasonable when I bought it. Can't be helped + If the spoons overlap in the additional spoon holder, it won't be washed. You should try to avoid overlapping the spoons as much as possible or place them alternately up and down to wash them. + Additional I use a dishwasher-safe lunch box, but the large one is starting to lose its shape. If I exclude the high-temperature drying and only wash for 55 minutes, the lunch box doesn't get weird anymore. Instead, I have to dry it naturally on the drying rack for a long time as if I washed the dishes by hand. So after dinner, I turn it on except for the high-temperature drying and leave it to dry in the dishwasher until the next morning. At this time, the door is slightly open, so it won't dry completely the next day, so it's better to leave the door wide open or take it out to the front of the drying rack tray. + 25.1. 13 Review after a little over a year of use I can't go back to a life without a dishwasher. You really have to buy it.

Sentence (English): I recommend this Bosch dishwasher because it's one of the few Series 4 dishwashers with a completely stainless steel tub.
Comments (English): [ Stainless steel tub ] || ---------------- || I recommend this Bosch dishwasher because it's one of the few Series 4 dishwashers with a completely stainless steel tub. You can read in the specifications of other models that they have a mixed tub with Polinox, which means they're made of two pieces, and this caused us problems with the previous Bosch dishwasher due to overflowing in the fifth year. Therefore, this model is suitable because its tub is made entirely of stainless steel. This used to mean that the dishwasher would be noisier, but they've greatly improved the technology, and this model is very quiet. You also have to be very careful when using the rinse aid, because this dishwasher needs it. With it, everything will come out very dry; without it, the 1-hour program will come out wet. We also chose it because it doesn't have the third rack, which, while it reduces capacity, makes the cutlery basket much more convenient.

Por ello, este modelo sí es adecuado porque su cuba está realizada en su totalidad en acero inoxidable. Esto antaño significaba que el lavavajillas sería más ruidoso, pero han mejorado mucho la tecnología y este modelo es muy silencioso. También hay que tener mucha atención en utilizar el abrillantador, porque este lavavajillas lo necesita. Con él saldrá todo muy seco, sin él sale mojado en el programa de 1h. Every evening when I turn it on, I'm happy. Until just a few days ago, I was living in dishwashing hell. This is also a hell of laziness. I hope my review was helpful.

I hope my review was helpful.

I hope my review was helpful.

It's incredibly simple to operate. - It's so easy to operate that you don't even need to read the manual. Even people who aren't mechanically inclined will find it easy to use. (I've attached a video.) - If you watch the video, you can hear my baby playing with toys in the background, which is even louder. That's how quiet the dishwasher is. This was actually one of the things I was most worried about. Since I wash the dishes after the baby sleeps, I was planning to run the dishwasher after the baby sleeps, but I was embarrassed that it was so quiet, even though I was worried it would be too loud. 4. If you leave the dishwasher running and go to bed, you might feel uncomfortable, but this product has an auto-open door function, so you can wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning. It's truly the best feature! 5. The lipstick removal is amazing. I actually thought lipstick wouldn't come off easily, but this was really surprising. 6. The interior seems a bit small. - It's marked for 6 people, but it's difficult for a family of 6. It seems perfect for a family of 4. Hmm. Actually, I'm new to dishwashing, so I think it might be because I didn't load the dishes properly. 2. People become lazy. Hahahahahahaha - I'm so happy. I wonder why I only found it now. Every evening when I turn it on, I'm happy. Until just a few days ago, I was living in dishwashing hell. This is also a hell of laziness. I came across this product through a good opportunity, but there's not a single lie in my review. There are so many expensive dishwashers, but this one seems to be a cost-effective dishwasher. I hope my review was helpful.

For five years, I thought my hands were the cleanest. I'm one of those people who thinks a dishwasher isn't necessary. No matter how good a dishwasher is, it can't compare to human hands. I got a chance to use a dishwasher, and my life has changed overnight! In fact, since I got married, I've been ordering delivery a lot, and my husband and I only eat dinner together once, so I haven't been bogged down in the dishwashing swamp. I used to think it was better to spend the money I'd spent on a dishwasher on something else. But then, after having a baby, I went from washing bottles to washing baby dishes. Now that my baby's eating baby food, I can't order delivery anymore and I'm cooking at home! From morning and lunch to dinner, the sink would be filled with dishes. After work, I'd finish washing the dishes and feel exhausted day after day. But meeting this dishwasher at such a good opportunity made me feel reborn. Advantages of the dishwasher: 1. First of all, it's not a built-in twin, so it's super easy to install. - The size felt slightly larger than it appears on the product page. I think it's because the inner diameter is marked. Since it was installed in my very small kitchen, I think it can be installed in most homes. 2. It's incredibly simple to operate. - It's so easy to operate that you don't even need to read the manual. Even people who aren't mechanically inclined will find it easy to use. However, you need to install the app to use the rinse/dry, glass care, and full wash menus, so installing the app is a must! 3. It's very quiet. (I've attached a video.) - If you watch the video, you can hear my baby playing with toys in the background, which is even louder. That's how quiet the dishwasher is. This was actually one of the things I was most worried about. Since I wash the dishes after the baby sleeps, I was planning to run the dishwasher after the baby sleeps, but I was embarrassed that it was so quiet, even though I was worried it would be too loud. 4. It has an auto-open door function. - This is a truly five-star feature. If you leave the dishwasher running and go to bed, you might feel uncomfortable, but this product has an auto-open door function, so you can wake up to fluffy dishes in the morning. It's truly the best feature! 5. The lipstick removal is amazing. I actually thought lipstick wouldn't come off easily, but this was really surprising. 6. They said it would remove grease well, but it's surprisingly fluffy. Disadvantages of the dishwasher 1. The interior seems a bit small. - It's marked for 6 people, but it's difficult for a family of 6. It seems perfect for a family of 4. Hmm. Actually, I'm new to dishwashing, so I think it might be because I didn't load the dishes properly. 2. People become lazy. Hahahahahahaha - I'm so happy. I wonder why I only found it now. Every evening when I turn it on, I'm happy. Until just a few days ago, I was living in dishwashing hell. This is also a hell of laziness. I came across this product through a good opportunity, but there's not a single lie in my review. There are so many expensive dishwashers, but this one seems to be a cost-effective dishwasher. I hope my review was helpful.

Comments (English): [ It's a really good dishwasher in many ways. ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Payment Date: February 11, 2025 - Arrival Date: February 13, 2025 Product Name: Media Countertop App-Linked Auto Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher, White, MDWTT0608(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for Choosing the Product: My previous home had a large, built-in dishwasher, but at the time, it was too big, took too long to load and run, and it was difficult to use with just a few items, so I didn't use it much. As time passed, I heard that various dishwashers were released, but I held off on buying one because I thought it wouldn't be used much, especially because of my previous experience. However, this time, we had a great opportunity to try the product we wanted, so we decided to buy it. Product Review: After using the product for a few days, I found several positive aspects. The most important ones were the cleaning power and the variety of modes. After using it for a few days, I tried putting in a pan I'd used for fried rice, a pot I'd used for boiling abalone porridge, and greasy side dish containers. I mostly used the standard mode with the drying feature added, and it washed cleanly every time. I was very satisfied with how all the grease and dried seasonings disappeared and the dishes came out sparkling clean. + The dishwasher was just the right size, which was nice. We're a household of four, but a dishwasher for six was just right. Since we don't just have rice bowls and soup bowls, I thought it would be appropriate to use a dishwasher with a little more space for the number of people. + The automatic door opening function after the wash cycle was complete was convenient. This allowed the heat to escape, greatly improving drying. + The strainer installed at the bottom of the dishwasher was neat, sturdy, and easy to remove. It was easy to keep it clean because it could be removed with a simple twist. + The installer was very helpful in providing various instructions, and it was also helpful in replacing the water line from the water purifier I was using. It was installed quickly by simply following the instructions and connecting it. + A disappointing part: This product does not support 5G Wi-Fi, so you must use regular Wi-Fi when connecting it to a smartphone. My arms were completely worn out, so I bought a dishwasher. For my arms~~ Purchase conditions: # Not too bulky: I didn't want my kitchen to look cramped, so I wanted the smallest size possible. The width and height are similar to other products, but the width is slim at 34cm, so the kitchen doesn't look cramped. # Pretty design: I was debating between a door product with a window and a windowless design, but I chose the one with a view inside because I could see the dishes being washed and it looked cooler. It also has an additional UV sterilization function. It was a little more expensive, but I think I made a good choice. Features: It has a two-tier basket, so you can stack more dishes. You can put large plates or bowls on the first floor, and then put cups or small bowls on the second floor. There are four courses; I usually use the regular course, and there are additional rinse and soaking functions that you can use when needed. It has upper, middle, and lower washing wings that spray the washing water evenly. The three-stage washing blades thoroughly clean the dishes. I used to blindly believe in hand washing, but now they're even cleaner and shine brighter. Glassware in particular is incredibly clean, with no water stains whatsoever. It's a whole new world. Following the robot vacuum, I've been living a completely comfortable life these days. I also love the automatic door-opening feature. After 65 minutes, the door automatically opens to remove any moisture inside. When the door opens, I take out the dishes, which are warm and dry, so I can get to work right away. I sometimes leave them on before bed and take them out in the morning, but they're cold, so I usually take them out right away when they're warm. A hot air drying feature would be nice, but that would cost more time and electricity. Initially, I was considering buying a brand from a major company, but I heard that various major companies are selling products made by media companies, so I chose this one. It's much more affordable. Coupang also offers a two-year warranty. If you found my review helpful, please click the "Helpful" button.

Media Countertop, App-Linked, Automatic Door Open, 6-Person Dishwasher. # This is my first time using a dishwasher. Some of my friends who didn't pre-wash their dishes had a problem where the dishes didn't come out clean. I'm still not very good at Tetris, so I thought I'd just wash them while I was at it, but I figured it was just because I'm a beginner. ## The cutlery holder hole is very large. The spoons kept popping out when I put them in because the hole was so large. It's hard to remove grease from plastic containers, but it came out clean. ## It dries automatically. After washing, wiping each dish with a napkin was another chore. It's a huge relief that the dishwasher dries perfectly, leaving almost no moisture behind. It seems to clean well even without conditioner. ## The automatic door open function. I highly recommend this. Even if it costs a little more, it's better to use it less and not have to worry about it, right? Since the door opens automatically, I don't have to worry about it. I haven't experienced the new world of dishwashers yet, but I plan to use it consistently~^^. Thank you Coupang for giving me this great opportunity~^^

I hope my review was helpful.

It's truly the best feature! 5. The lipstick removal function is amazing. I actually thought lipstick wouldn't come off easily, but this was really surprising. 6. Every evening when I turn it on, I'm happy. Until just a few days ago, I was living in dishwashing hell. This one made me lazy. I came across this product through a good opportunity, but there's not a single lie in my review. There are so many expensive dishwashers, but this one seems to be a cost-effective dishwasher. I hope my review was helpful.

I hope this helps with your purchase :)
